brand_identity.name: DIVE
brand_identity.tone: Friendly, confident, witty. Smart friend, not a bank.

equity.style: Minimalist, big bold numbers, smooth line charts.

fd_banking.style: Traditional, serif typography accents, highly structured.

bonds.style: Data-heavy, dense rows, high contrast text.

gold.style: Dark mode premium, metallic gradients, sleek.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter text-text_primary leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.wrapper: flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center justify-center min-h-screen bg-background_wrapper px-4 py-20 lg:py-0 overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.scrollytelling_text: lg:w-1/2 flex flex-col justify-center space-y-24 py-32 px-8 lg:px-16

phone_frame.container: relative w-[340px] h-[720px] rounded-[3rem] border-[8px] border-gray-900 bg-background_app shadow-[0_24px_60px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] overflow-hidden shrink-0
phone_frame.notch: absolute top-0 inset-x-0 h-6 bg-gray-900 rounded-b-3xl w-40 mx-auto z-50

cards.default: bg-surface_card rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-border transition-all duration-300

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-4 to p-8 aggressively inside the phone app. Outside the phone, use py-24 to py-32 for scrollytelling steps.

motion_and_animations.general: Smooth, spring-based micro-interactions. No sudden snaps.
motion_and_animations.dive_score_reveal: Framer Motion SVG circle path animation, starting at 0 and filling up to the score, changing color from red to amber to green/blue.
motion_and_animations.xray_donut_melt: Layout transition where the initial top-level category pie chart splits into smaller nested sectors using Framer Motion layoutId.
motion_and_animations.staggered_entrance: Lists and cards fade in and slide up with a stagger delay of 0.1s.
motion_and_animations.bottom_sheet: DIVE Bot overlay slides up from the bottom (y: '100%' to y: 0) with a bouncy spring physics config (stiffness: 300, damping: 30).
motion_and_animations.scrollytelling_sync: As user scrolls the outer wrapper, the phone frame's content changes based on the active IntersectionObserver section.

buttons.primary: bg-brand_blue text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold hover:bg-brand_blue_hover transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-brand_blue/20
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-text_primary border border-border rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-surface_card_hover transition-colors

inputs.default: w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-white px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand_blue/50 transition-shadow

data_visualization.rings: Use pure SVG with stroke-dasharray for progress rings. Round caps.
data_visualization.bars: Rounded full bars (rounded-full) for before/after comparisons in Suggestions.

components_guidance.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case representing their role (e.g., 'simulate-slider', 'dive-bot-trigger').

onboarding.description: Splash cards, OTP form, and Account Aggregator consent.

home.description: Main dashboard showing DIVE score and top insights.
key_elements: Apparent vs Real Diversification stat blocks

dive_bot_hub.description: Grid of other simulated apps to show DIVE's popup behavior.
key_elements: Clicking one opens a fake UI of that app, then the DIVE Bot slides up from the bottom to warn/praise.

abstract_backgrounds.description: Soft light blue/white bokeh, use as a subtle background for the outer scrollytelling wrapper or splash screen.

avatars.description: Smiling Gen Z profile image for the Profile section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'framer-motion' for all scrollytelling interactions and the DIVE Score ring/donut animations.
Implement the landing page with an outer flex/grid container. The phone frame remains 'sticky' on desktop while the text sections scroll past.
Inside the phone frame, implement a standard React Router or state-based view switcher to navigate between the app screens.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. You can use standard Tailwind utility fonts for fallback, but load Cabinet Grotesk from a CDN or local asset.
For the DIVE Bot Demo Hub, create 5 distinct mocked screens (Equity, FD, Bonds, REIT, Gold). When the user opens one, show the DIVE Bot sliding up from the bottom.
Ensure all buttons, sliders, and interactive cards have `data-testid` attributes.
